model: OXIDE RETURN TAPE ECHO MODEL AR-62

motion.note: the tambour's pixels slide right by `slide` as it opens, cut off at the lid's right edge where its slats roll away behind the ear; the recess shows where it has gone

rack: OXIDE RETURN, Ardenti's tape echo (an example rack's faceplate)
coordinate_space: face pixels: the clean face plate at the house pitch, for both views; the host scales the whole rack uniformly

rack_pitch.note: EIA: 19 in panel, 1.75 in per unit

face.conversion: scaled by 0.995349 to 2140x537, then the trim's flat bars (scaled rows [[8, 15], [506, 513], [525, 532]]) stretched by [18, 18, 18] rows to 591

tempo.conversion: registered to closed.png by a shift of [-0.072, 0.167] px, then converted as the face

bindings: each element binds its rack unit (an index into the design's units) and the unit module's local key; the host resolves the registry parameter per placed rack

face:plate.note: the knobs' index lines, TIME's needle and the lamp's light removed (polar fills, the needle's round the scale's centre, its hidden 300 ms tick copied from the 150 ms one, the lamp unlit); the hub, the buttons, legends, ticks, ears and the closed tambour kept

tempo:plate.motion: drawn over the face plate at its anchor while the tambour is open
tempo:plate.note: the tambour's footprint and wherever the drawings differ: the recess, NOTE's, CROSS's and WOBBLE RATE's lines removed; alpha feathers its edge into the face plate
